process: Hand-shaped earthenware with broad alternating light and dark wet-clay slips drawn through with a comb to make repeated feathered passages.
status: Coordinator accepted the exact waxwing first unchanged after actual 540/170/85, six own, ten coordinator and 53 app-selector comparator views. Four more independent siblings plus wallpaper may use only this first as the material reference. The backwater idea was dropped after a clay river turtle was observed in Billabong Clay.
cornerCompanion: Rolled clay seal form, cedar waxwing, pulled slip lines, cut hour ticks, leaf hands, shallow glaze-pool charge area and a folio calendar. The corner companion is three curved parallel slip trails bent across two perpendicular comb passages.
firstGateCriterion: Repeated feather bends visibly pull across continuous thick alternating wet-clay trails on one fired earthenware body. At 85 px, the species, clay edge and combed light/dark field still read separately from matte clay or free-marbling neighbors.

retiredId.reason: Actual Billabong Clay has a clay river turtle and water lily.
